doc.brief: The QAbstractItemDelegate class is used to display and edit data items from a model.
doc.index_brief: Used to display and edit data items from a model

QAbstractItemDelegate(QObject *parent).brief: Creates a new abstract item delegate with the given *parent*.

QSize sizeHint(const QStyleOptionViewIte.brief: This pure abstract function must be reimplemented if you want to provide custom rendering.

QWidget * createEditor(QWidget *parent,.brief: Returns the editor to be used for editing the data item with the given *index*.

bool editorEvent(QEvent *event, QAbstrac.brief: When editing of an item starts, this function is called with the *event* that triggered the editing, the *model*, the *index* of the item, and the *option* used for rendering the item.

bool handleEditorEvent(QObject *editor,.brief: Implements standard handling of events on behalf of the currently active *editor*.

bool helpEvent(QHelpEvent *event, QAbstr.brief: Whenever a help event occurs, this function is called with the *event* *view* *option* and the *index* that corresponds to the item where the event occurs.

void closeEditor(QWidget *editor, QAbstr.brief: This signal is emitted when the user has finished editing an item using the specified *editor*.

void commitData(QWidget *editor).brief: This signal must be emitted when the *editor* widget has completed editing the data, and wants to write it back into the model.

void destroyEditor(QWidget *editor, cons.brief: Called when the *editor* is no longer needed for editing the data item with the given *index* and should be destroyed.

void paint(QPainter *painter, const QSty.brief: This pure abstract function must be reimplemented if you want to provide custom rendering.

void setEditorData(QWidget *editor, cons.brief: Sets the contents of the given *editor* to the data for the item at the given *index*.

void setModelData(QWidget *editor, QAbst.brief: Sets the data for the item at the given *index* in the *model* to the contents of the given *editor*.

void sizeHintChanged(const QModelIndex &.brief: This signal must be emitted when the [sizeHint](xref:qt:QAbstractItemDelegate)() of *index* changed.

void updateEditorGeometry(QWidget *edito.brief: Updates the geometry of the *editor* for the item with the given *index*, according to the rectangle specified in the *option*.
